entities.summary: Turki bin Nasser Al Saud was a Saudi military officer, who served as the head of the presidency of meteorology and environment as well as state minister for environmental issues in Saudi Arabia. He was a member of the House of Saud and one of the grandsons of Saudi's founder King Abdulaziz.
